result.title: CAST-ASD: Causal Attention over Speakers and Time for Online Active Speaker Detection
result.summary: We present CAST-ASD (Causal Attention over Speakers and Time), a causal joint model for active speaker detection (ASD). Recent ASD models improve performance by jointly processing all faces in a scene, but operate offline, with the full clip available before any frame is labelled. Low-latency causal detectors instead process each face independently. CAST-ASD combines joint face reasoning with fully causal inference. It applies scene-level attention across faces within the current frame and causal temporal attention over each face's history, enabling information sharing across speakers with zero lookahead. Its parameter count does not grow with the number of faces. On MSDWild, where most negative face-frames contain a visible competing speaker, CAST-ASD reduces competing-speaker false alarms by 32% relative to the causal per-face detector it extends, with larger gains as scene occupancy increases. It outperforms all causal baselines on both validation splits while using only one-tenth the inter-speaker parameters of a three-block fixed-roster convolution. Code and models are available at https://github.com/prathamg007/CAST-ASD.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CAST-ASD，一个用于在线主动说话人检测（ASD）的因果联合模型：在当前帧内做跨人脸的场景级注意力，并对每个人脸的历史做因果时序注意力，实现零前瞻的说话人间信息共享，参数量不随人脸数增长；在 MSDWild 上把竞争说话人误报降低 32%，并为在线低延迟检测提供开源代码与模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「零前瞻因果时序注意 + 场景级关系聚合 + 参数量不随实体数增长」的可供核查线索，可能对应 LVR 的增量状态更新、视觉实体关系保留与在线计算分配问题；但任务是音视频说话人检测，能否迁移到 latent 视觉推理主线尚需核查。
